provenance.locator: implemented physical inputs and exact definitions

formulas.saturationPressurePa: saturationPressurePa = saturationPressurePrefactorMbar * exp(saturationPressureExponentK / temperatureK) * mbarToPa, where saturationPressureExponentK is the signed value -6150 and no second unary minus is applied
formulas.uniformControl: when alphaHKConst = 0, sigma(r) = sigmaInfinity at every node, both growth velocities and the Robin residual are bitwise zero
formulas.sphericalTrapezoidWeights: weight_i = radius_i^2 * actualSpacingM * (1 / 2 for endpoints, 1 for interior nodes); the common 4 * PI angular factor cancels
formulas.normalizedResiduals: shell and uniform errors divide by max(abs(sigmaInfinity), Number.MIN_VALUE); Robin residual divides by max(abs(alphaHKConst * sigmaSurface), abs(kineticLengthM * surfaceGradientPerM), Number.MIN_VALUE)

caseProcedure: derive physical scales from the frozen signed-exponent equations
solve the shell and Robin equations as a two-unknown linear system
evaluate every node from the frozen node-rule binary64 spacing
derive flux and Hertz-Knudsen velocities independently from the solved surface state
emit every floating operand and result as decimal plus big-endian binary64 hexadecimal identity
uniformControlProcedure: require the uniform field, exact shell, bitwise-zero rates, and bitwise-zero Robin residual
referenceDerivation.actualSpacingRule: expectedActualSpacingM is the exact binary64 evaluation of (farRadiusM - radiusM) / expectedIntervalCount; the rational micrometre identity is checked within binary64 roundoff and is not used to reconstruct the bit pattern

targetedCheck.independentParameterization: derive the finite-shell dimensionless Robin strength Lambda and closed-form surface/profile without importing or repeating the generator two-by-two solve
checks: exact operand and requested/actual roster echo
independent physical-scale identities including the signed saturation-pressure exponent
surface and both velocity relative errors
shell, uniform zero-attachment, and Robin residual normalized errors
all four cases and the uniform control are present
targetedCheck.aggregateRule: every exact identity and every less-than-or-equal tolerance must pass for all four cases

negativeControls.mutation: remove only the production-side finite-shell contribution while the frozen reference remains unchanged
negativeControls.independentWitness: the production raw witness SHA-256 must move while the frozen reference identity remains byte-identical

negativeControls.mutation: change only a producer-reported radial error or summary verdict without changing raw witness bytes
negativeControls.independentWitness: a verifier distinct from the mutation author proves raw reference and witness identities did not move
negativeControls.expected: the independent evaluator ignores the forged summary or reports disagreement

negativeControls.mutation: change only the production-side Robin attachment coefficient alphaHKConst or its boundary use
negativeControls.independentWitness: the production raw witness SHA-256 must move while the frozen reference identity remains byte-identical
negativeControls.expected: the independent numerical evaluator fails; reference independence is neither established nor attacked by this mutation

independence.scientificArithmeticSeparation: the two-by-two harmonic generator and closed-form Lambda checker share frozen schemas and operands but no scientific-arithmetic implementation
permittedSharedCode: artifact identity and strict schema parsing
independence.dependencyAudit: recursively resolve every local TypeScript import from generator and checker, hash every closure member, require the exact shared allowlist intersection, and refuse any forbidden path before derivation
independence.testHooks: testAlphaOverride, testExtraSeedSites, testMode, fabricated resume state, and equivalent substitutions are forbidden

terminalSemantics.earlyReferenceArtifact: S5b may publish one immutable radial reference or a discrepancy refusal from the clean S5a ancestor
terminalSemantics.packetCompletion: the produce packet remains incomplete until S6 production witness, evaluation, attempt ledger, and controls are terminal
terminalSemantics.referenceReopener: S6 may only reopen and byte-match the committed S5b artifact; it cannot regenerate, select, or tune it
terminalSemantics.discrepancyOutcome: a generator/checker discrepancy publishes a scoped refusal and does not alter this protocol
terminalSemantics.aggregateRule: any C0V layer failure or refusal prevents aggregate C0V PASS
